harm.label: Harm Clock
harm.description: Fill segments when you take harm. 1500/1800/2100: treatable with first aid. 2200/2300: needs a professional. 0000: acquire agricultural property.

armor.label: Armor
armor.description: Reduce incoming harm by this value before filling your Harm Clock.

cred.label: Cred
cred.description: Abstract currency for gear, cyberware, and services.

xp.label: XP
xp.description: Mark experience toward your directives. At 10, take an advance.

directives.label: Directives
directives.description: Your two Personal Directives plus the current Mission Directives.

links.label: Links
links.description: Your relationships with the other characters. Roll Links to help or interfere.

contacts.label: Contacts
contacts.description: People you can go to for help. Roll Style to hit the street.

intel.label: [Intel]
intel.description: Hold gained during Legwork. Spend to reveal knowledge.

gearHold.label: [Gear]
gearHold.description: Hold gained during Legwork. Spend to produce equipment.

vehicles.label: Vehicles & Drones
vehicles.description: Your cyber-linked vehicles and drones, with their strengths, looks, and weaknesses.

cyberdeck.label: Cyberdeck
cyberdeck.description: Your deck and its matrix capabilities.

instinct.label: Instinct / Want
instinct.description: What this threat wants and how it acts.
